chapter_title: Opioid Kappa Receptor Selective Agonist TRK-820 (Nalfurafine Hydrochloride)

records.role_detail: selective agonist; page 95 calls it a selective and potent full agonist for the κ receptor
records.quote: TRK-820 (nalfurafine hydrochloride) is a selective opioid κ receptor agonist
records.numbers_given: Ki, Kd, Bmax, IC50, Imax, EC50, Emax
records.numbers_detail: Table 1 (PDF 94), kappa Ki (nM) by study: 3.5; 0.075; 0.36; 0.244; 0.225 (mu Ki: 53; 5.2; 0.71; 2.21; 0.582; delta Ki: 1200; 161; 49.9; 484; 96.5). Kd for [3H]TRK-820 0.46±0.03 nM, Bmax 284±43.3 fmol/mg protein (PDF 94). Functional kappa values (PDF 95): IC50 (κ) = 0.15±0.07 nM (Seki et al.), 0.00816±0.00138 nM (Nakao et al.); EC50 (κ) = 0.025±0.003 nM, Emax (κ) = 93±5% (Wang, Y et al.).
records.notes: Target class is the page's own wording (opioid receptor); no inference. Same compound-target pair stated again on PDF 94, 95 and 105.

records.mechanism_book_wording: partial agonist for the μ and δ receptors
records.quote: TRK-820 was a selective and potent full agonist for the κ receptor and partial agonist for the μ and δ receptors.
records.numbers_detail: PDF 95: IC50 (μ) = 8.3±1.4 nM, Imax (μ) = 69±3% (Seki et al.); IC50 (μ) = 1.66±0.09 nM, Imax (μ) = 53.2±1.3% (Nakao et al.); EC50 (μ) = 3.2±1.3 nM, Emax (μ) = 54±7% (Wang, Y et al.). Page also says Mizoguchi et al. exhibited partial agonist activity of TRK-820 for the μ receptor.
records.notes: Page also states TRK-820 had no μ antagonist activity against morphine analgesia; not recorded separately because it is a negative statement. Mu rule name uses the book's 'μ receptor' plus the opioid context of the chapter.
